evidence.detail: R145 ClientSidebarPanel adds rs/s/c/d under exact tab title 'Development' only when rs/s/c/d.b() reports developer tools enabled; otherwise the same slot is occupied by ItemSearchSidebarPanel.
The panel preserves exact actions 'Reset Item Defs', 'Reset NPC Defs' and 'Repack cache' with exact commands '::itemdef reset', '::resetnpcdefs' and '::repack'.
Its live state uses exact modes 'Recoloring N/A', 'Recoloring NPC', 'Recoloring Item' and 'Recoloring Object', plus exact controls including 'Color inverse', 'Hide modified' and 'Copy selected'.
The class emits exact Development feedback such as 'Color string added to keyboard!' and manipulates the editor/recolor model consumed by the live developer interface.

proposals.note: DeveloperToolsSidebarPanel is fixed by conditional exact 'Development' tab placement and its reset/repack/recolor developer-tool surface. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: R145 ClientSidebarPanel adds rs/gui/G under the exact tab title 'Item Search' whenever developer tools are not enabled.
The panel refuses search until the item-definition database is loaded and shows the exact warning 'Please wait until the client has loaded the item database!'.

Its search action requires at least three letters, iterates the exact cached item-definition table, matches item names case-insensitively, excludes the reserved item id 11283, and renders matching item ids/names plus exact '(noted)' state.
The class extends JPanel and owns the live search JTextField, Search button, result JTextArea and scroll pane used by the sidebar tab.

proposals.note: ItemSearchSidebarPanel is fixed by exact ClientSidebarPanel placement and exclusive item-definition search/result behavior. Confidence is 0.999.
